history.summary: Cheapest entry in the batch — D19 Sengkang leasehold (2003), 2BR at $1.10M / $1,111psf on 990sqft, 280m from SE2 Rumbia LRT. Strong 6.23% URA over 93 txns, frontier, high arena score (799). Low quantum is the appeal; the catch is LRT-only access (no MRT) and a deep-OCR Sengkang location with limited near-term catalysts.
history.rating_rationale: At $1.10M / $1,111psf this is genuinely affordable and the 6.23%/yr URA (93 txns) is solid, with asking ($1,111) close to the $1,037 median. But the unit relies on Rumbia LRT, not MRT — a real liquidity/desirability discount versus MRT-served peers — and Sengkang's private-condo appreciation leans on the broader OCR cycle rather than a specific zone catalyst. Good value and easy entry quantum, offset by LRT-only transit and a generic OCR location. Balanced Neutral leaning positive.
red_flags: LRT-only access (Rumbia LRT) — no direct MRT, narrower buyer appeal
2003 build (~23 yrs) — ageing asset, lease decay
Deep-OCR Sengkang — appreciation tied to general cycle, no specific catalyst
catalysts: Next to Rivervale Plaza mall; LRT links to Sengkang MRT/interchange

history.summary: Not actually cheap: $1,111 psf is ABOVE the project's 12mo avg ($1,057), on a 2002/2003 unit with ~76yrs lease left near an LRT (not MRT). The 'cheap' signal is a leasehold-decay/thin-data artifact.
history.rating_rationale: The dossier's -23.1% age-adj reads as a bargain, but it's a leasehold-decay artifact: this unit is from 2002/2003 (~23-24yrs old, ~76yrs lease left) and the 'very_old_property' + 'very_low_psf' flags fired. Web shows 12mo transactions of $953-$1,112 psf (avg $1,057), so the asking $1,111 psf is at the TOP of recent range — and psf_premium_vs_cohort is +6.2% on just 3 cohort txns. So it is not cheap vs real comparables; the model's value signal is corrupted by age-adjustment and thin data. Location is Sengkang OCR near Rumbia LRT (not MRT) — modest connectivity. OCR is the better forward region per v3.4, but that doesn't rescue a unit priced above its own recent comps with a decaying lease and no catalyst. Avoid for a 5-7yr hold.

psf_premium +6.2% on only 3 cohort txns — thin, unreliable
Rumbia LRT only (no direct MRT) — limited connectivity
catalysts: D19 OCR — favorable forward region in v3.4 priors (but insufficient alone)
Behind Rivervale Mall — daily amenities at the doorstep

Would re-rate Neutral only if transacted nearer ~$1,050 psf.
